notes.zh-CN: 回合进行中发出的消息改为排队：不再打断正在做的工作，等这一轮结束后自动按顺序发送，输入框上方会显示排队中的内容并可以取消。同时修复了多会话发送被挡住的问题——一个对话在运行时，其他对话（以及从首页新建的对话）都能立刻发送，不会再提示“上一条消息还在发送”。
notes.en: Messages typed while a turn is running are now queued: nothing is interrupted, and each queued message is sent in order as soon as that turn ends, with a note above the composer that shows what is waiting and can cancel it. Sending is also no longer blocked across conversations — a running turn in one chat (or a new chat started from home) never shows "a message is still being sent".
